root_cause: Frozen test clock predates server startup and can cross the signing epoch; AWS presigning uses wall time while fixture computes expiry from stale time.
fix: Default fixture clock follows wall time plus explicit manual advances. Epoch-sensitive retention test explicitly retains a frozen FakeTimeProvider. Valid SigV4 test asserts fixture time has not frozen behind wall time after startup.
execution_owner: Separate ShapeMirror worker; reviewed and integrated by benchmark owner
parallelism: Five runs using default TUnit parallel execution; no limiter or workflow changes
limits: Executed before rebase. Current-head required CI remains gate; raw logs, test credentials and target configuration are not published.
